messages:
Maya: customer ACME-Prod on Dedicated reporting repeated 429s and long tail latency this morning. They say autoscaler requested new replicas but pods stuck in 'attaching' ~60-120s. Ticket #12456.
Ethan: can you drop the attach/pod logs and the autoscaler events from the window?
Maya: pasted sanitized attach log snippet below:
```
2026-03-17T09:01:58Z attach: request received route=acme-main qps=120
2026-03-17T09:02:14Z attach: starting attach for allocation 0xabc
2026-03-17T09:02:46Z kube: imagepull backoff from registry.redwood: rate limited
2026-03-17T09:03:12Z attach: auth token refresh failed: iam quota exceeded (429)
2026-03-17T09:03:47Z attach: attach timeout waiting for accelerator ready
```
Maya: repro steps customer ran for us:
1) steady 250 r/s for 30s hitting dedicated route
2) concurrent connections spike to 200
3) observe attach latency then 429s at client
curl repro (sanitized):
```bash
for i in {1..500}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done; wait
```
Ethan: initial read: combo of registry pull throttling + IAM token rotation/quotas. Autoscaler did request pods but imagepulls stalled attach path. Also saw node with high GPU memory eviction which could be noisy neighbor.
Priya: checked infra metrics: registry burst bucket hit at 09:02:40 for that cluster, and there was a scheduled KMS rotation job at 09:02 which triggered IAM refreshes. Billing shows customer has reserved "burst credits" available.
Liam: customer insists they had reserved burst capacity and expected faster scale. They were on plan: dedicated-tier-burst with reserve tokens=1500.
Maya: mitigation applied to customer account: bumped min_replicas from 1 -> 3 for their route, enabled prewarm for next 24h, and temporarily prioritized their attach queue. Asked them to retry during quiet window.
Ethan: longer term recommendations: (a) decouple imagepull + attach ACK so attach can ack earlier and let background pull finish, (b) add per-customer registry backoff + token pooling to avoid IAM storm during KMS rotation, (c) surface attach latency in Console SLOs.
Priya: opened INF-789 to request registry rate-limit increase for dedicated clusters and add background pre-pull for reserved customers. Also added a note to ops-runbook to avoid KMS rotations during predicted customer ramp windows.
Maya: asked for a short repro window this afternoon; customer agreed to run a 5m ramp test at 14:00 PT.
DevOps-Bot: triggered canary deploy: eng-runtime/decouple-attach-2026-03-17 -> canary nodes (2). See CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/changes/decouple-attach-2026-03-17
Maya: will follow up after the 14:00 window with results and next steps. tagging @Liam to align CS comms with customer. :thumbsup:
Ethan: assigning follow-ups: INF-789 (Priya), RUNTIME-421 (Ethan) for attach decouple, and SUPPORT-12456 (Maya) for customer validation.
Liam: I'll prepare the status update for the customer and include the temporary mitigations and the schedule for the infra ticket.
Maya: thanks all — logging this thread into the ticket and closing the loop after afternoon repro.
